findings: Logout redirect points to Supabase URL — POST /api/auth/logout constructs the redirect with process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL as the base, sending users to https://xxxx.supabase.co/login in production instead of the app. Fix by using NextResponse.json({ success: true }) and letting the client navigate, or pass request.url as the redirect base.

Storage RLS policies are commented out — supabase/schema.sql leaves the storage.objects policies as SQL comments. Any authenticated user can call the Supabase Storage REST API directly to delete or read arbitrary files in the documents bucket, bypassing the app's manager-only enforcement. Uncomment and apply the three storage policies.

No VIEW audit log on file access — /api/files/[id]/url issues a signed URL without writing an audit_logs record. The ActionType enum includes VIEW but it is never used. Add an audit_logs insert with action: 'VIEW' in that route.

Mismatched and unpinned uuid types — @types/uuid is pinned to ^10.0.0 (targets v10 API) while uuid runtime is ^14.0.2 (v14 API). All dependencies use ^ ranges, meaning a fresh Vercel build can pull different versions than those tested locally. Pin all versions to exact releases.
